ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40% high-intensity (white) pixels to 60% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity white contiguous zones located on the lateral lobes. The right lobe white zone contains three distinct dark horizontal linear segments. The left lobe white zone shows high-density dark mottling at the medial interface and tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated angle of approximately 55 degrees and a narrow vertex depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile; visible peaks and valleys ranging from 5 to 20 pixels in depth along the continuous boundary from notch to tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature fitted to the trailing edge of both lobes, transitioning to sharp upward-sloping tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, circular low-intensity clusters located along the superior margin of the white patches and at the extreme lateral tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, nearly parallel dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented horizontally on the lower half of the right lobe's white section.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent rake marks on the right lobe and significant irregular erosion/pigment loss along the superior trailing edge of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular 'bleeding' or feathering effect at the pixel interface between the white lateral patches and the black central fluke body.
